name: marp-theme-figure-poc
description: Minimal Marp proof of concept for theme-aware inline SVG figures

scripts.build:online: npm run assets && marp slides.md --theme-set themes/base.css --theme-set themes/online.css --theme-set themes/dark-room.css --theme-set themes/bright-room.css --theme online --html --output dist/online.html
scripts.build:dark: npm run assets && marp slides.md --theme-set themes/base.css --theme-set themes/online.css --theme-set themes/dark-room.css --theme-set themes/bright-room.css --theme dark-room --html --output dist/dark-room.html
scripts.build:bright: npm run assets && marp slides.md --theme-set themes/base.css --theme-set themes/online.css --theme-set themes/dark-room.css --theme-set themes/bright-room.css --theme bright-room --html --output dist/bright-room.html
scripts.build:all: npm run build:online && npm run build:dark && npm run build:bright && npm run build:index
scripts.preview: marp slides.md --theme-set themes/base.css --theme-set themes/online.css --theme-set themes/dark-room.css --theme-set themes/bright-room.css --theme online --html --preview
